population.interpretation: Research-licensed MIT-Adobe FiveK Expert C 16-bit TIFFs with exact embedded ProPhoto ICC; source-selected without target pixels, one source per make/model. These are native wide-gamut rendered photographs, not film, stock, calibration, HDR or product-ingress evidence.

mechanism.ingress: ROMM/ProPhoto encoded RGB to D50 XYZ, Bradford D50-to-D65 adaptation and extended linear Rec.2020
mechanism.gamut_mapping: out-of-Rec.2020 pixels only, along the source luminance-neutral RGB axis into a two-code RGB16 interior
mechanism.look: unchanged U1.4C3 source-anchored safe-Lab residual execution

interpretation: The analytical luminance-axis mapping and unchanged C3 residual mechanism pass all frozen support, compression-stress, luminance, boundary, style-retention, scale, gradient and order gates on twelve native ProPhoto photographs. The result confirms the mechanism beyond display-sRGB-derived stress inputs, but the source is still FiveK and internal research-only, so independent-source confirmation remains required before product ingress.
claim_ceiling: Development-only native ProPhoto-to-relative-display-Rec.2020 boundary-safety and style-retention evidence; not arbitrary ICC/profile support, film, stock, calibration, HDR, ACES, preference or product ingress.
